issues.description: Typo 'stlib' should be 'stdlib' in deprecation docstring
issues.detail: In falcon/testing/helpers.py the new deprecation note reads 'Use the stlib's :func:`contextlib.redirect_stdout`...'. This will render in user-facing Sphinx docs. Fix to 'stdlib' or 'standard library' for professionalism.

issues.description: Deprecation test may not capture warning due to decorator ordering / context manager semantics
issues.detail: The @deprecated decorator is applied outside @contextlib.contextmanager. The deprecation warning fires when the user calls `testing.redirected(...)` (generator construction), not on `__enter__`. The test wraps both the call and `with` block inside pytest.warns so it works, but any caller assigning the cm to a variable before `with` would still trigger the warning at call-time — worth confirming that's the intended UX.

issues.description: Newsfragment uses '.misc' classification for a user-visible deprecation
issues.detail: docs/_newsfragments/2569.misc.rst announces a deprecation that affects public API users. Falcon's towncrier config typically has a dedicated 'deprecation' fragment type; using '.misc' may bury the change in the wrong changelog section. Verify the convention matches other deprecations (e.g. httpnow).

issues.description: Deprecation test does not assert stderr path also still works
issues.detail: tests/test_testing.py only exercises `stdout=output`. Since the deprecated wrapper still ships in 4.3 and users may rely on the `stderr=` kwarg, a parametrized or second case covering stderr redirection would prevent silent regressions during the deprecation window.

issues.description: Import ordering of `contextlib` in test file may violate isort grouping
issues.detail: In tests/test_cmd_inspect_app.py, `import contextlib` is inserted between `from argparse import Namespace` and `import io`. Falcon's style typically separates `from` and plain imports; if isort/ruff-isort is enforced in tox, this may fail lint. Worth confirming the formatter accepts the new arrangement.

review.summary: The PR is small, well-scoped, and the mechanism (deprecation decorator + stdlib swap in internal tests + new regression test) is correct. Main issues are cosmetic: a 'stlib' typo in user-facing docstring, possibly wrong towncrier fragment type ('.misc' vs '.deprecation'), and a thin deprecation test that omits the stderr path. One subtle concern: the deprecation warning fires at generator-construction time due to decorator ordering, which is fine but worth being intentional about.
